page: Microsoft Azure E128-32ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. It utilizes an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance allocates 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled (2 threads per core). Cache resources include 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large shared 260 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and hardware-accelerated cryptographic primitives.

Hardware capacity is defined by a massive 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a high 32.0 GB per vCPU ratio typical of constrained-vCPU memory-heavy configurations. The system does not include discrete GPUs. For local storage, it bundles 7559 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity. Network architecture does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong raw memory subsystem performance, registering large-block uncached read throughput of 238.84 GB/sec and write throughput of 137.13 GB/sec, placing it in the top quartile of evaluated instances. Computational scores are consistently solid, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2086.0 and multi-core score of 16779.0. CPU instruction throughput tests show strong capabilities in PassMark physics (7302.83) alongside average general multicore metrics (stress-ng multicore score of 31881.31 and PassMark CPU score of 47316.29). In inference tasks utilizing AMX and AVX-512, prompt processing for small and medium LLM architectures reaches 2558.78 and 179.21 tokens/sec respectively.

By constraining compute to 32 vCPUs while retaining a full terabyte of memory and 7.5 TB of fast NVMe storage, the E128-32ds_v6 offers strong cost efficiency for enterprise software licensed on a per-core basis. It is suited for in-memory enterprise databases, SAP HANA, Redis caching clusters, high-throughput static web serving, and memory-intensive ETL operations.
description: Microsoft Azure E128-32ds_v6 is a memory-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs and 16 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz. Designed for workloads requiring an extreme memory-to-compute ratio, it supplies 1024.0 GB of RAM alongside 7559 GB of bundled NVMe SSD storage, without attached GPUs. The architecture supports modern vector and matrix extensions such as AVX-512 and AMX, paired with a massive 260 MB L3 cache. Benchmark testing highlights strong memory throughput, measuring 238.84 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 137.13 GB/sec for writes, alongside strong Geekbench scores (2086.0 single-core, 16779.0 multi-core). The constrained-core footprint maximizes cost efficiency for software licensed per core while delivering massive RAM and local storage, making this server ideal for in-memory databases, large caching layers, and high-throughput data processing.
